per_view.notes: Long slender gray tube with blunt untapered nose. Front-third hump with cockpit patch reads 747-like but sits as a stacked capsule. Two boxy nacelles visible, low under thin swept wing; four not confirmable. Swept fin present; tailplane a thin spike. Nose strut plus clustered wheels under engines. Clean even window line; flat monochrome gray livery.

Slender grey tube with swept tapered wings, swept fin and tailplanes, and nacelles with open inlets under the wings (three clearly visible). No upper-deck hump; nose is a flat unfaired cylinder cap. Window row present but no cockpit glazing. Only a tiny nose strut, no main gear. Monochrome but coherent scheme.

Slender tube with partial-length hump carrying its own window row and a dark cockpit band, but the nose is a flat cylinder cap with no taper. Three to four underslung pylon nacelles with dark inlets visible. Swept tapered wings, swept fin, small tailplane. Nose strut plus several belly bogies; gear struts thin, hump block-like.
